purpose: Exclude a specified item from a set.
keywords: N + 以外; clause + 以外に
It is open every day except Sunday.
Please do not give the key to anyone other than the person concerned.
formation: N + 以外; clause + 以外に
restrictions: Often combines with negative predicates to mean nothing except.
mistake: Keep the excluded item distinct from the remaining set.
